# hpe_morpheus_backup (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Backup resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_morpheus_backup" "example" {
  name            = "DB Backup"
  instance_id     = 1
  backup_type     = "lvmSnapshot"
  retention_count = 7
  enabled         = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the backup.

### Optional

- `backup_type` (String) The backup type code.
- `container_id` (Number) The ID of the container to backup.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the backup is enabled.
- `instance_id` (Number) The ID of the instance to backup.
- `retention_count` (Number) The retention count.
- `schedule_id` (Number) The ID of the execute schedule.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the backup.

## Import

Import is supported using the resource ID.

```bash
terraform import hpe_morpheus_backup.example 123
```
